name: liandre-bootstrap-sass-portfolio
description: Single-page portfolio rebuilt with Bootstrap utilities/components and Sass variable overrides.

scripts.dev: npm run copy:bootstrap && sass src/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --load-path=node_modules --watch
scripts.build: npm run copy:bootstrap && sass src/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --load-path=node_modules --style=compressed --no-source-map && npm run create:dist
scripts.create:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R index.html robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest llms.txt assets dist/ && rm -f dist/assets/css/*.map && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete
